text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wah, that's an incredible crowd of people.
Welcoming the New Year, I went to Hatsumode with Yukino Bijin to pray for success in the Senior class.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Whether in Morioka or the big city, everyone's
feelings when making a wish are pretty much the same.
choice_data_list: We should make our wishes properly too.
Let's make sure we make our wishes properly too.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes!

I looked at the profile of Yukino Bijin with her hands pressed together in solemn prayer.
Standing beside her, I prayed just as earnestly for her happiness.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
What should we do next?
We still have a little time before training, don't we?
choice_data_list: What do you want to do, Yukino?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Mmm~...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Should I eat something sweet,
go for a stroll, or goof off a little...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...This is about all I could come up with,
what do ya think?"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Um, well then, there's a parfait
I've really been wanting to try...!

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for waitin'~. Here are your two winter-limited
"Snow Bunny Parfaits"~.

What the clerk brought over was a pure white parfait
modeled after a snow rabbit.
A little mochi rabbit sat perched on top.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hawaaaaaaa...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
T-Trai-Trai-Trai-Trainer.
N-N-Noo... N-Noodles, noodles!
choice_data_list: Yeah, you're so cute, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
*yaaawn*...!
What do I do, where should I start eating from!?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
Before that...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Um, could you take a picture for me?
A two-shot with this snow bunny!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Thank you!
Your face looks kinda like mochi, you know.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: —And send.
choice_data_list: Who did you send it to?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: It's City-san!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "City-san was the one who told me in the first place that this parfait suits me!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
People've always told me I look like a mochi.
So, I kinda made my face look like that too, teehee.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I hope this
makes City-san smile.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hm?
From Yukino...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Haah!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, creepy.
Are you gonna be okay?"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Well then,
let's dig in!
(Stab!)

Yukino Bijin mercilessly stabbed
her fork right into the head of the snow bunny...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Let's see...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "Shall we take the scenic route home?"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, right.
Care to play a little game with me?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
It's just that I refuse to ever stop, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
For example, you have to stop at a red light, right?
When that happens, you just take a path where you don't have to cross!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: If it's a dead end, just turn right back around and keep pushing forward anyway!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Back home we hardly had any traffic lights, so it's a game you can only play in the city.
Did you get the rules?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Well then,
shall we be on our way?"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
Trainer, the light's red!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
The road is closed!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Let's turn back!

And so, continuing forward straight ahead
with Yukino Bijin without stopping—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wah...!
What a beautiful place...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah!
She stopped in her tracks."
choice_data_list: Shall we take our time looking around as we go?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes!

And so, Yukino Bijin and I took our time
strolling through the flower field we had stumbled upon.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yay!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
“Still, is there any kind of game
we can play in such a tight space?”
choice_data_list: All I can think of is...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: The arcade?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
True, you can play in short bursts
and spend your time however you like, which is great.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...
I don't really know much about it.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm not really used to this,
so picking one is kinda tough.

text_block_list.name: High School Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hey, wanna try that dance thing?
We only ever film them, after all~.

text_block_list.name: High School Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good.
Let's give it a shot~

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: City girls sure are so carefree and graceful.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...Um!
There's a game I really wanna try!"
choice_data_list: Alright, let's do whatever it takes!
Sure, let's do whatever you want!

text_block_list.text:
And as for the game
Yukino Bijin picked...

text_block_list.name: Zombie
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaaaaaggghhhhh
hhhhhhhrrrrrkkk!!!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer!
I'm coming to save you!!
(*SHING!*)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Looks like we won! We did it!
choice_data_list: You didn't seem scared at all, Yukino...
Yukino, you didn't seem scared at all...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It's all right!
I know it's just a game, after all.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Whew, that was a whole bunch of fun, yes it was!

Seeing how satisfied Yukino Bijin was,
I gained a newfound respect for her.
